failure_summary.description: Optional fields were placed in the required-parameter list, including puzzle IDs, dice counts, word length, and a postal code.
Email verification calls did not consistently use endpoints matching the requested validation capability.
A Wayfair catalog search was omitted while the related item-specific checks were included.

patch.reasoning: The most repeated error was misclassifying optional fields despite their placement being specified in each tool schema. Make the schema-classification rule explicit at serialization time; the other failures are isolated and the existing skill already covers operation decomposition and capability-based tool selection.

edits.target: Use each endpoint's exact parameter names and required/optional placement. Bind every constraint only to the call it modifies; do not carry dates, limits, filters, or pagination across operations.
edits.content: Classify every argument from the selected tool's schema before serialization: put only fields marked required under `required parameters`, and put all fields marked optional under `optional parameters`, even when the user supplied the value or the field is needed to express a requested refinement. Never promote an optional field to required. Bind each constraint only to the call it modifies; do not carry dates, limits, filters, or pagination across operations.
